coverage_limitations: Inventory membership and expected-contract replay are not model-accuracy or operational-answer evidence.
Pantheon domains have no reviewed crosswalk to semantic intent cases, so their semantic contract coverage is reported as zero rather than inferred from labels.
Ontology query functions are counted from declared query function constants; runtime binding, evidence availability, and answer correctness are separate gates.
Operating-domain question counts overlap because one question-bank domain can support more than one constitutional operating domain.
Golden answer oracles cover only reviewed Golden questions; candidate membership is not answer-fidelity evidence.
No question-level presentation oracle or repository-owned paired model comparison exists yet, so those coverage slices remain zero rather than receiving inferred credit.
Source-level presentation contract coverage is not browser scenario evidence.

model_change_policy.combined_change_rule: A model and prompt change evaluated together is a combined treatment, not model-only evidence.
model_change_policy.control: Use the same exact-source question cohort, ontology release, principal manifest, evidence snapshot, prompt catalog, locale, and runtime policy for baseline and challenger.
model_change_policy.presentation_rule: Models propose meaning only. Deterministic presentation planning selects renderer-neutral blocks from verified evidence shape, and browser checks validate the rendered experience.
model_change_policy.promotion_rule: Every required metric and slice must meet its target; no aggregate score may compensate for a hard-zero violation, an unsupported slice, or a worst-slice regression.
model_change_policy.reviewer_independence: The answer model cannot review itself; use at least two independent reviewer families after deterministic semantic, evidence, completeness, calibration, scope, and authority gates.

scoring_policy.empty_denominator: not_scored; never coerce an unsupported slice to 1.0
scoring_policy.exact_target_set: multiset equality over kind, value, source_start, source_end, and canonical_value
scoring_policy.model_comparison: paired baseline and challenger cases under MODEL_CHANGE_POLICY controls
scoring_policy.pillar_aggregation: conjunctive; report each pillar and worst slice, never one compensating weighted score
scoring_policy.presentation_scoring: deterministic artifact checks plus exercised desktop, constrained-desktop, and mobile scenarios
scoring_policy.promotion_support: Every required topic, locale, discourse mode, evidence posture, and action posture must have at least one scored case; aggregate targets cannot hide an unsupported slice.
